verdict.rationale: Neon is a serverless Postgres database, so analytical query performance is a fair question to ask of it. The pack, however, contains no documentation of columnar storage, OLAP acceleration, or benchmarks showing large-table aggregations fast enough for dashboards. Autoscaling and Read Replicas appear only as bare page titles with no stated analytical capability, so they are at most adjacent features.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run heavy analytical aggregations over large tables fast enough for dashboards without exporting to a separate warehouse
